triggerHint.subscribe: Replies when a fan follows; a follow through a channel QR code uses the scan rule of its scene first
triggerHint.keyword: Replies when a fan's text (or recognized voice) matches a keyword
triggerHint.default: Replies to a fan's message no rule matched (never to events)
triggerHint.click: Replies when a fan taps a menu click button with the same key
triggerHint.scan: Replies when a fan scans a channel QR code with the same scene (a scan to follow too)

reply.keywordPlaceholder: Type a keyword and press Enter
reply.keywordHint: Up to {max}, each at most 30 characters; leading and trailing spaces and letter case are ignored
reply.priorityHint: Higher values match first; at the same priority exact matches come before contains matches
reply.clickHint: Exactly the key of the menu button (case-sensitive)
reply.scanPlaceholder: Pick a channel QR code of this account, or type a scene
reply.scanHint: Letters, digits, underscores and hyphens only, at most 64
reply.materialNeedsBrowse: Choosing a material also needs the permission to view materials; ask an administrator
reply.soleHint: An account can have one enabled follow reply and one enabled default reply
